name: heirlooms
mood: HEIRLOOMS — the jewelry of a company's world: rare showpieces earned by milestones. The richest materials and the strongest contrast in any room: gleaming gold with bright white specular glints, deep jewel-toned velvet, polished lacquer, carved jade, crystal. Precious, grand, a little theatrical, never tacky. Each is an ORIGINAL design grounded in a real decorative tradition (Art Deco, Qing jade carving, Victorian brass) and must not resemble any furniture from an existing video game.

items.prompt: The Founders' Throne: an Art Deco armchair-throne with a tall fan-shaped back carved as a gilded sunburst with stepped rays, deep peacock-blue velvet seat and back panel with button tufting, gilded lion-paw feet, gold ball finials, a tiny engraved brass plaque on the front rail.
The SAME Art Deco Founders' Throne seen from behind: the back of the tall gilded sunburst fan with its stepped rays, peacock-blue velvet back panel, gold ball finials, gilded lion-paw feet.

The Jade Dragon Lamp: a carved translucent green jade dragon with fine scales and flowing whiskers coiled around a slim gilded pillar, its claw raised holding a glowing pearl-white paper lantern that radiates warm light, on a round carved rosewood base with gold trim.
The SAME jade dragon lamp seen from behind: the dragon's carved jade back and tail coiled around the gilded pillar, the glowing pearl-white lantern held above, the carved rosewood base.
The Gold Reserve: a neat stepped pyramid of seven gleaming gold ingots with stamped faces (no text) on a black lacquer and walnut display plinth, with dazzling white glints on the gold.

The Crystal Globe: a clear crystal world globe with softly frosted continents, held in a brass armillary cradle of rings, on a slim turned walnut pedestal with a round gilded foot; light refracts through the crystal.

A black lacquered concert grand piano with its lid propped open showing the golden harp and strings inside, gold-rimmed curved body, ivory and black keys facing along the red arrow, turned legs with brass casters, a small velvet bench in front of the keys.

The SAME black lacquered grand piano seen from the curved tail side (the keys face away from us): the long curved glossy black body, the propped-open lid showing the golden harp, turned legs with brass casters.
The Launch Bell: a big polished brass ship's bell hanging from a carved oak A-frame gallows with brass fittings and a braided white rope with a tassel; the bell gleams with bright glints.
The Keystone Trophy: a tall gold two-handled trophy cup with engraved laurels on a stepped white-and-grey Carrara marble plinth with a small gold plaque (no text).

A Victorian aquarium: a long glass tank framed in ornate polished brass with a domed brass hood, clear blue water with orange-and-white koi and a black moor goldfish, swaying green plants, pebbles and a little stone arch, standing on a carved mahogany cabinet with brass feet. Its long glass side faces along the red arrow.
The SAME brass-framed Victorian aquarium on its carved mahogany cabinet, seen from the other long side: the same koi, goldfish, plants and stone arch through the glass.

sheets.name: throne-back
sheets.note: The second reference image is this exact throne from the front. Draw the SAME throne turned fully around so we look at it from directly BEHIND: the outside of the tall gilded sunburst back is nearest to us and hides the seat completely; we see the plain peacock-blue velvet back panel framed by gold rays, the gold ball finials, and the gilded lion-paw feet at the bottom. Same materials, proportions and pixel style.
